findings.title: Headline revenue and daily rows disagree by a factor of 1,000

evidence.description: Card shows $420,000 while Day 1-3 rows sum to $420

findings.symptom: Revenue (USD) card reads $420,000 for All days; the detail table in USD lists $120, $140, $160 which sum to $420.
findings.consequence: A reader cannot tell which figure is right or what unit scale each uses, so the number cannot be quoted in a review.
findings.recommendation: State the unit scale on both figures or make them consistent.
acceptance_criteria: Headline and detail rows use the same unit scale or both state their scale
A reader can reconcile the total with the rows without outside knowledge

findings.title: Reporting period control does not say whether the table or only the headline changes

evidence.description: Selected period shown in two places

findings.symptom: The Reporting period select and the card caption both say All days, and the screenshot gives no cue whether the detail table follows the filter.
findings.consequence: A first-time reader may not know whether changing the period updates the rows they are comparing against.
findings.recommendation: Label the table with the applied period.
acceptance_criteria: The table heading names the applied period

findings.title: Snapshot freshness is stated twice with the same timestamp

evidence.description: Review clock and Last updated lines

findings.symptom: Review clock and Last updated both read November 10, 2026, 12:00 UTC.
findings.consequence: Minor repetition; the expert must read both to confirm freshness.
findings.recommendation: Merge the freshness statements into one line.
acceptance_criteria: Freshness appears once, next to the headline figure
